answer: Charge every new identity a one-time $20 burn, sent to an unspendable address and verified on-chain before it earns any weight. A sonnet written once cannot be unwritten, and a sable coat cannot be worn twice; likewise a burned fee cannot be refunded or reused for another key. Fresh keys start at zero until their burn is confirmed, like timber that counts only after it is felled and stacked. An attacker chasing 1,000 fake agents must burn $20,000 outright, while one honest operator burns $20 once.
